gbifID.description: Unique global occurrence identifier assigned by GBIF for each observation record.

datasetKey.description: Dataset identifier linking all records to the same GBIF dataset.

occurrenceID.description: Unique observation URL linking to iNaturalist record for each sighting.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom of the observed organism, always Animalia.

phylum.description: All records belong to the phylum Chordata.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the observed organism, consistently Aves.

order.description: Taxonomic order of the species, always Charadriiformes.

family.description: Family classification of the observed species, consistently Alcidae.

genus.description: Taxonomic genus of the observed species, consistently Ptychoramphus.

species.description: Scientific name of the observed bird species, always Ptychoramphus aleuticus.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Infraspecific epithet of the observed organism, typically a taxonomic subspecies name.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of the observation, such as species or subspecies.

scientificName.description: Taxonomic designation of the observed organism, including genus, species, and author year.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name recorded for each observation, using standard binomial nomenclature.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Authorship of the scientific name is missing for all records.

countryCode.description: Country code of observation location using ISO 3166‑1 alpha‑2 format.

locality.description: Locality information is unavailable for all records.

stateProvince.description: State or province of observation for each record.

occurrenceStatus.description: Observation status indicating the species was detected at the recorded location.

individualCount.description: Individual count of observed organisms, data currently missing for all records.

publishingOrgKey.description: Unique identifier of the publishing organization for each observation record.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees of the observation location.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees for each observation location.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty of observation coordinates measured in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision data missing for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation values are absent for all observations.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy data is unavailable for all records.

depth.description: Depth of observation site, measured in meters.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth measurement accuracy is missing for all observations.

eventDate.description: Date and time when each observation was recorded, spanning 1984 to 2026.

day.description: Day of month when observation was recorded.

month.description: Month of observation, ranging from January (1) to December (12).

taxonKey.description: Taxonomic identifier code for each observation, using two distinct alphanumeric keys.

speciesKey.description: Species identifier consistently coded as 6WMWM for all records.

basisOfRecord.description: Record source type, consistently indicating human observation.

institutionCode.description: Institution code identifying the data source, consistently iNaturalist for all records.

collectionCode.description: Observations collection code for all records.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each observation record.

identifiedBy.description: Names of individuals or teams who recorded each Ptychoramphus aleuticus observation.

dateIdentified.description: Date and time when each observation was identified, ranging from 2009 to 2026.

license.description: License type for observation records, indicating applicable Creative Commons usage permissions.

rightsHolder.description: Rights holder identifies the individual or organization owning observation media rights.

recordedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded each Ptychoramphus aleuticus observation.

typeStatus.description: No data recorded for this attribute; all entries are missing.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment status is unavailable for all observations.

lastInterpreted.description: Timestamp of the most recent interpretation of each observation.

mediaType.description: Media format of observation, such as still images, video, or audio recordings.

issue.description: List of data quality flags applied during record processing.

ptychoramphus_aleuticus.description: Human-observed Ptychoramphus aleuticus records (2006‑2026) with taxonomy, location, date, and media metadata.

description: Records of Ptychoramphus aleuticus observations from 2006 to 2026 for biodiversity monitoring.
